intro: The M139 is at the heart of some of Mercedes-AMG's most exciting models. From the compact A-Class hot hatch to the refined SL roadster, we work on every M139 application with precision and care.

rows.title: M139 in the A-Class
rows.body: The M139 in the A-Class is one of the most common applications we see — the A 45 AMG and the A 45 S AMG (W177, 2019–present).

rows.title: M139 in the CLA
rows.body: The M139 in the CLA is one of the applications we work on regularly — the CLA 45 AMG and the CLA 45 S AMG (C118, 2019–present).

rows.title: M139 in the GLA-Class
rows.body: The M139 in the GLA-Class is one of the applications we work on — the GLA 45 AMG and the GLA 45 S AMG (H247, 2020–present).

rows.title: M139 in the C-Class, GLC-Class & SL
rows.body: The M139 is the performance engine of choice in the current C 43 AMG (W206), the GLC 43 AMG (X254), and the entry-level SL 43 (R232) — applications we work on regularly.
